quarterly_data.signal: BofA 2026 Taiwan Tech Forum deck: 2Q 2026 gross profit was 58% and operating income 34% of net sales (1Q26: 59% and 32%; 2Q25: 58% and 33%). MPI describes itself as a probe card total-solution provider (fine-pitch CPC, high-speed VPC and low-force MEMS) offering one-stop probe head, substrate (MLO/MLC/MLOC) and PCB service, and says it works closely with worldwide market leaders, especially in AI and HPC applications (company statement).
